title: Wet or Dry: vizes and száraz

sections.title: What the rain leaves behind
sections.content: vizes ("wet") and száraz ("dry") describe what the weather leaves behind. When it rains, the street becomes vizes; once the sun has been shining for a while, everything is száraz again. An esernyő ("umbrella") is what keeps you száraz in the eső.

items.spanish: Esik az eső, az utca vizes.
items.english: It's raining, the street is wet.

items.spanish: Nálam van esernyő, és száraz vagyok.
items.english: I have an umbrella with me, and I'm dry.
My clothes are wet from the rain.

sections.content: vizes and száraz are also handy far outside the weather — vizes kéz ("wet hand"), száraz haj ("dry hair"). Learn them once, use them everywhere.
